root_cause.text: The `amdgpu_userq_get_doorbell_index` function in the `drm/amdgpu` subsystem fails to validate that the user-provided `doorbell_offset` is within the bounds of the allocated doorbell buffer object (BO) before calculating the doorbell index.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a bounds check in `amdgpu_userq_get_doorbell_index` to verify that `(u64)db_info->doorbell_offset * db_size + db_size` does not exceed the size of the doorbell buffer object (`amdgpu_bo_size(db_obj->obj)`) before calling `amdgpu_doorbell_index_on_bar()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Validate the doorbell offset to ensure it lies within the bounds of the doorbell buffer object, preventing out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check to validate that the doorbell_offset multiplied by db_size, plus db_size, does not exceed the size of the doorbell buffer object (BO).
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds memory access by returning an -EINVAL error and jumping to the cleanup label if the requested doorbell offset falls outside the allocated buffer object bounds.
